---
title: "Good Software Engineering Practice for R Packages"
---

A four-session mini-series for **JnJ (online)**, taught in English by
**Daniel Sabanés Bové**. Learn how to build reliable R packages through
presentations and live demos. Participants can execute the completed examples
on their own laptop alongside the instructor.

## Sessions and downloads

| Session | Date | Slides | Complete demo code |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1. R package structure and building it | 19 November 2026 | [Slides](slides/01_packages.qmd) | [Session 1 ZIP](slides/download/session-01.zip) |
| 2. Workflow, clean code and unit tests | 20 November 2026 | [Slides](slides/02_workflow_tests.qmd) | [Session 2 ZIP](slides/download/session-02.zip) |
| 3. More on tests and Shiny development | TBD | [Slides](slides/03_tests_shiny.qmd) | [Session 3 ZIP](slides/download/session-03.zip) |
| 4. Code optimization and AI best practices | TBD | [Slides](slides/04_optimization_ai.qmd) | [Session 4 ZIP](slides/download/session-04.zip) |

Session times and the dates for sessions 3 and 4 are to be confirmed.

## Before joining

Experience writing R functions is recommended. Install [R](https://www.r-project.org/)
and [RStudio](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/).
For session 1, install [Rtools on Windows](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/)
or the [macOS build tools](https://mac.r-project.org/tools/) as appropriate.

Download and extract the ZIP for your session to a writable folder. Open the
included `.Rproj` file and run `source("setup.R")` once before joining.
This installs only the packages needed for that demo and requires internet access.
Then run `source("demo.R")`, or execute its sections alongside the instructor.
For session 3, `source("launch-app.R")` opens the Shiny app; stop it with Escape
in RStudio or Ctrl+C in a terminal.

Each download is self-contained, with completed code, synthetic data generated
locally, a README, and its license. No code from a previous session is required.
Session 4 includes an optimization demo; AI best practices are covered in the slides.
